name: mouse
comment: The mouse and the wheel act on the page at the pointer's position; needs a graphical frame, as a terminal shows no canvas.

steps.comment: the canvas fills the window body

steps.eval: (defun ladybird-elate-event (type x y &rest rest) (ladybird-elate-in-page (let ((posn (posn-at-x-y x (+ y (window-header-line-height (get-buffer-window))) (get-buffer-window)))) (setq unread-command-events (append unread-command-events (list (append (list type posn) rest)))))))

steps.comment: a press and its release arrive at the canvas position, scaled to device pixels
a double click carries its count, a right click its button
wheel events scroll by their pixel delta, or by lines

assert.eval: (let ((dpr (ladybird-elate-in-page ladybird--dpr))) (equal (mapcar (lambda (m) (list (alist-get 'dy m) (alist-get 'precise m))) (seq-filter (lambda (m) (equal (alist-get 'kind m) "wheel")) (ladybird-elate-log "mouse"))) (list (list (round (* 24 dpr)) t) (list (round (* -24 dpr)) t) (list (round (* 2 (default-line-height) dpr)) nil))))

steps.comment: the selected page window reports mouse movement
